title: Create a view template from a view and bulk-assign it to other views
task: Snapshot a tuned view's settings into a view template with View.CreateViewTemplate, then standardise many views at once by setting each target view's View.ViewTemplateId to it. Covers view templates and bulk standards application.

pitfalls.symptom: Setting View.ViewTemplateId appears to do nothing, or the template does not apply to a target view.
pitfalls.cause: The template must be valid for the target view's type (a floor-plan template only controls plan views).
pitfalls.fix: Call View.IsValidViewTemplate(templateId) on each target before assigning, and skip the ones it returns false for.

pitfalls.symptom: After assigning a template, later edits to a target view (scale, filters, V/G overrides) are silently ignored.
pitfalls.cause: Those properties are now controlled by the view template, so the view itself is read-only for them.
pitfalls.fix: Edit the template (or the source view then re-create it), or leave a property uncontrolled in the template's Include settings so views keep their own value.
